description: Save a detailed handoff for the NEXT chat window / session. Stores: current progress, TODO list (done + remaining), changed files with descriptions, instructions for the next assistant, and any incomplete work. The next session_start automatically includes this handoff so the new window knows EXACTLY what happened and what remains. Call this BEFORE closing a chat window, especially if work is incomplete. This prevents the "continue" problem where new windows lose context, skip tasks, or produce broken code.

blocked_on.description: If work is blocked, describe what is needed to unblock (e.g. "waiting for API deploy", "needs user input on design")

completed_tasks.description: Tasks that were fully completed (e.g. "Implemented brainSearch() in JS SDK")

context_summary.description: Brief summary of what happened this session (architecture decisions, key findings, blockers)

files_changed.description: Changed files with their current state — marks partial/broken files so next window knows to fix them

description.description: What was changed and what still needs work

path.description: File path relative to project root

instructions.description: Free-form instructions for the next assistant. Be specific: what to do next, what to avoid, what broke.

remaining_tasks.description: Tasks NOT yet done — the next window MUST pick these up

name: session_handoff
